concerns.text: T020-TEACHER is marked incomplete ('[ ]') yet is a hard prerequisite for FR-009 (Trace Entropy Validation) and T022-TRACE. The task description relies on a 'deterministic rule-based engine' but does not explicitly mandate the generation of the token-level probability distributions required for KL-divergence and trace entropy calculation. Without this explicit deliverable, the FR-009 constraint (filtering based on trace entropy) cannot be satisfied, constituting a semantic weakening of the spec.

T013 (Generalization Set generation) and T044 (Distinctness Verification) are marked incomplete ('[ ]'). FR-008 explicitly requires a structurally distinct Generalization Set (N>=500) to measure generalization. The tasks list lacks a concrete, verifiable implementation plan for generating this set and validating its structural distinctness (e.g., via the `structure_hash` algorithm mentioned in T050 but not integrated into the generation flow). This creates a dead end where a mandatory FR is unimplementable.

T014 (Contradiction Detection/SAT check) is marked incomplete ('[ ]'). The Spec (Edge Cases) and FR-001 require the system to detect and filter unsolvable problems to ensure valid teacher traces. Leaving this task incomplete means the generator may produce invalid data, violating the 'Valid Synthetic Dataset' constraint and breaking the downstream distillation pipeline.

T061 (CPU-Only Enforcement) is deferred to 'Post-Analysis Resolution'. FR-003 and Constitution Principle VII mandate that the pipeline MUST run strictly on CPU and fail if GPU is detected. Deferring this critical architectural constraint to a post-analysis phase violates the 'CPU-Bound' constraint preservation, as the core implementation (Phase 4) proceeds without this enforcement, risking invalid results if the environment changes.

T017 (Checksum recording) is marked complete ('[X]') despite T013 and T044 (the tasks that generate the files to be checksummed) being incomplete. This is a semantic contradiction: one cannot checksum files that have not been generated and validated. This indicates a false positive on task completion, weakening the 'Data Hygiene' constraint (Constitution Principle III).
